summary: Jami is a universal communication platform designed to preserve user privacy and freedoms. It operates as a decentralised system for messaging and calls without relying on centralised servers. Because the exact protocol details are broad, it broadly addresses the problem of peer-to-peer digital communication and data sovereignty.
goodFor: It is a suitable fit for users and organisations seeking decentralised communication channels that avoid mainstream, proprietary metadata-tracking networks.
